description: All 84 Ceiba listings offline, with market math, comps, and change tracking over a local mirror.

novel_features.name: Change digest
novel_features.description: See new listings, price drops, and status flips since a prior sync — a Saturday-morning scan of the whole catalog.

novel_features.name: Price-per-acre leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank budget-filtered listings by price per acre, cheapest first.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side compare
novel_features.description: Aligned feature table for 2-4 named listings in one call.

novel_features.name: Comparables with deltas
novel_features.description: Nearest peer listings for one property, with price and per-acre deltas; sold comps opt-in.

novel_features.name: District market report
novel_features.description: Counts, median price, median price per acre, and status mix for a district and its towns.

novel_features.name: Mirror coverage report
novel_features.description: Per-field fill rates across mirrored listings so operators know which answers the mirror can currently support.
